title: vFlow: Visual Flow Cytometry & Immunofluorescence Analysis Tool
description: vFlow desktop gating and single-particle analysis. Candidate 4.4.3rc17 fixes sample selection/activation and unintended Cycle navigation, preserves displayed samples and saved Overlay views, isolates Pan/Zoom from gate editing, validates gate widths, and improves shortcut/context-menu ownership. Includes all RC16 workspace integrity and recovery changes. Scientific algorithms and benchmark acquisitions are unchanged. See UI_INTERACTION_REVIEW_v4.4.3rc17.md for current validation and platform limits.
